purpose: M00 is the contract between the Academy and the learner. It orients the learner, establishes a useful baseline, connects learning to one real One Water problem, sets evidence and participation boundaries, and produces a personal Learning Charter.
staffSummary: Build the front door to One Water AI. The learner should finish knowing why the program matters to their work, where they fit, how they will participate safely, what they want to produce, and what they will do first. Do not turn M00 into a required coding or software-installation lesson.
learnerOutcomes: Explain what One Water AI teaches, what it does not authorize, and why human accountability remains visible.
Identify one real One Water problem or professional opportunity that will anchor the learning.
Complete and interpret a readiness baseline across role, AI fluency, data and evidence, governance, technical confidence, and organizational support.
Select a relevant role lens while recognizing that the complete curriculum remains shared and connected.
Classify learning information as approved, restricted, uncertain, or in need of human approval.
Create a One Water AI Learning Charter with a target work product, support needs, success evidence, and first accountable action.
Locate optional technical preparation without treating programming skill as a universal entry requirement.
curriculumOutcomes: Establish one common participation, evidence, privacy, and human-authority contract.
Capture a useful baseline that later modules can revisit.
Connect the learner to one shared curriculum and one relevant role lens.
Create the first Fieldbook artifact and a durable starting record.
Route technical preparation to optional labs or the modules where it is used.
marketingOutcomes: Promise clarity, a personal starting point, and a governed path to a useful professional work product.
Describe pathway selection, a readiness baseline, and the Learning Charter.
Do not promise promotion, salary change, savings, compliance, certification, implementation success, or mastery.
definitionOfDone: The learner completes the orientation acknowledgement, readiness diagnostic, pathway choice, information-boundary check, saved Learning Charter, and first-action commitment.
scopeBoundary: Required M00 setup covers access, support, accessibility, safe participation, approved storage, pathway choice, and the Learning Charter. Terminal, application programming interface key, secret-file, and code-editor instruction remains preserved as optional preparation or placement candidates for M25 and M40.
